Repro written. Bug found, nothing fixed.

**`repro.md`** → `.bridza/pipelines/engineering/card-archiving-is-not-working-when/repro/outputs/repro.md` (+ `repro.mjs`, two-device script).

## Root cause

`setTaskArchived` (`server/bridza-run.js:1071`) writes `archived` into the **task worktree**, then `commitWorktree(W, …)` commits it onto `bridza/<pipeline>/<task>`. Base branch never touched.

Every other board-wide flag commits at repo root → syncs fine:

| state | target | syncs |
|---|---|---|
| pipeline archived, kanban order, `#refs`/tombstones | `commitPaths(root, …)` | ✅ |
| **card archived** | `commitWorktree(W, …)` | ❌ |

## Why it never reaches the other machine

- Archive button exists to declutter **Delivered** → used *after* finalize → no future merge carries flag to `main`.
- `git ls-remote --heads origin` → 4 branches, **zero `bridza/*`**. Bridza has no push/pull; task branches never published.
- 30 task `metadata.json` on `origin/main`, **none** has `archived`. Only hit is `"__archived__"` — the *column id* in `kanbanOrder`, root-written. That's why the Archived column syncs and shows up, permanently empty. Exactly the reported symptom.
- Device B: no local `bridza/*` head → `readTaskMeta` falls back to `main`'s file → `archived: !!undefined` = `false` → `currentStage()` skips `ARCHIVED_COL` (`board.jsx:22`).

UI is correct. It faithfully renders `archived: false`.

**Pushing task branches would not fix it** — `branchExists` checks `refs/heads/` and `scanBranches` scans `refs/heads/bridza/`. Clones get `refs/remotes/*`. Fix must put the flag on the base branch.

## Two things worth flagging

- Origin of the bug is the spec: `kanban-archive-issue-cards/build/prompts.md` said commit it "the same way `setTaskReuse` writes task flags". `setTaskReuse` is a per-worktree runtime pref — branch-local OK. `archived` is cross-device display state — branch-local wrong.
- Existing test (`bridza-run.test.js:677`) asserts only worktree + branch tip. Never asserts `readProject(root)`, never crosses a clone. Passes while feature is broken.

Archive intent **not lost** — it's in commits on the other machine's branches, recoverable via `git log --all --grep='bridza: archive task'`.

## Caveat

Could not execute `repro.mjs` — `node` and `pnpm test` both required interactive approval this session. Root cause established from source + this repo's git state; every claim in the doc is backed by a shown command and its output. Script is ready to run when execution is permitted.

Fit check: single root cause, single-commit fix → **Bugfix flow correct**. Implemented.

## Root cause
`setTaskArchived` wrote `archived` into the task worktree + committed to `bridza/<pipe>/<task>`. Task branches never pushed, readers only see local heads → flag cannot cross devices. Device B reads base-branch metadata → `!!undefined === false`.

## Fix (shared path, not per call site)
Archive = board state, so store it where pipeline-archive & kanban order live: repo root, base branch.

- `server/bridza-store.js:250` — `readRefs` gains `archived: { "<pipe>/<task>": bool }` in `.bridza/refs.json` (same file as delete tombstones, which solve the identical branch-independence problem).
- `server/bridza-store.js:263` — new `setTaskArchived`, writes + `commitPaths(root, [".bridza/refs.json"], …)`.
- `server/bridza-store.js:408` — `readProject` reads refs.json; falls back to legacy `meta.archived` when no entry, so pre-fix archives still show; explicit `false` outranks a stale flag.
- `server/bridza-store.js:767` — `deleteTask` retires the archive entry with the `#ref`.
- `server/bridza-run.js:1070` — branch-local version deleted (no worktree spawned just to archive now).
- `server/bridge.js:27` — only caller (`/task/archive`); import moved. Endpoint/client/`board.jsx` unchanged.

## Tests
New `bridza-store.test.js` → `task archive state`, 3 cases: cross-device (archive → commit on `main` → **clone base branch only, no `bridza/*` head** → reads archived `true`), legacy-flag honour + clear, delete drops entry. Old `bridza-run.test.js` case (asserted only worktree+branch — why bug shipped) removed.

`npx vitest run` over all 6 node suites: **166 passed**.

Caveats:
- 3 `.jsx` suites not run — no `node_modules` in worktree, `pnpm install` needed approval. They don't touch changed code.
- `repro.mjs` import updated one line (API moved); couldn't execute it — `node <script>` needs approval here, so verification is via vitest, which covers the same two-device path.
- Changes left uncommitted for the pipeline's stage commit. Summary written to `fix/outputs/fix.md`.
